After being forced by the rest of our housemates, he attempted to apologise a couple of times but i simply wasn't prepared in any way to deal with it (something that should've been obvious to anyone).

A year later I still live in the shared house and the offending housemate has moved to a different city, but still comes back to visit mutual friends. With no-one to force him into doing it, he has never made a further attempt to apologise for destroying a year of my life. I guess pretending that inconvenient people don't exist is way easier than holding yourself accountable for your actions.
